state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 6 (typed values): every reader of ADR 0278 § 1's `Entry` roster is on `main`, and wiring the schema into the readers is the stage's last open item.** Stages 1 to 5 are done, and Stage 4 is done except for a CA that a program supplies. Both checks of Stage 6, `nvs-stdlib-ldap-typed-values` and `ldap-typed-values-run`, pass against `samba-ad`. Stage 7 (writes and passwords) is the earliest red check.

**On `main`**: `Ldap\Connection::whoami`/`search`/`read`, `Ldap\Entries`, `Ldap\Entry`, `Ldap\Scope`, `Ldap\Settings`, `Ldap\Filter`, `Ldap\Dn`, `Ldap\Ad`, `Ldap\Sid`, `Ad\AccountFlags`, `Ad\GroupType`, and `Entry`'s typed readers `int`, `bool`, `uuid`, `sid`, `sids`, `instant`, `duration`, `accountFlags`, `groupType`, `accountType`. `int` and `bool` read RFC 4517's INTEGER and `TRUE`/`FALSE` through `nvs_ldap::value::int`/`boolean`. `nvs_ldap::Cursor::next` fetches every ranged attribute to its end. `crate::ldap::schema(ctx, key, member)` reads the subschema once per block pool per core, and no reader consults it yet: an `Ldap\Entry` holds only its DN and attributes, so it cannot reach its connection.

Server cases reach `samba-ad` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`) at `ldaps://localhost:16636`. `CN=Users` holds exactly three users: `Administrator` (`userAccountControl` 512, `primaryGroupID` 513, `adminCount` 1, `isCriticalSystemObject` TRUE), `Guest` (66082, `pwdLastSet` 0, `primaryGroupID` 514, no `adminCount`) and `krbtgt`. `Domain Admins` is `groupType` -2147483646 and `CN=Administrators,CN=Builtin` is -2147483643 with more than one `member`. GUIDs, SIDs and times change each time the container is made, so a case asserts their shape, never the value.

items.text: **`Connection::modify` as one request, and `add`/`delete`/`rename`** (ADR 0278 § 1's roster, `rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`'s "a value is written in the form it is read"). The wire operations go beside `Connection::search` at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs:397`, the `Ldap\Change` value and the four rows beside `ENTRY` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:531`. Closes `modify_applies_its_changes_in_one_request` and `typed_values_round_trip_through_a_write`, and `tests/conformance/core/ldap-add-modify-delete-rename.nvst`.

**`setPassword`/`changePassword` over `unicodePwd`, encrypted only, and `compare`** (ADR 0278 § 1). `Connection::is_encrypted` at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs:333` is the gate. Closes the other four names of `nvs-stdlib-ldap-writes-and-passwords` and `tests/conformance/core/ldap-set-password.nvst`.

**The readers take the base type from the schema** (`rule:core-classes/ldap-value-types`), Stage 6's last item. `crate::ldap::schema` is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs:603`. `Entry` needs a slot for the schema it was read under, filled where `entry_value` builds it at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:121`; no check fails without it, so it may follow Stage 7.

backlog: A CA a program supplies to `Ldap::open` (Stage 4's rest), ADR 0278 § 2.
The AD extras: sort with VLV, deleted objects, DirSync, the Global Catalog (Stage 9).
The feature proofs for every `Core\Ldap` group (Stage 10), `bun nv proofs --owed`.
